items.title: European Tech Stocks Hit by AI Boss Risk Warnings
items.title_ko: European Tech Stocks Hit by AI Boss Risk Warnings
items.summary_ko: Equities fell around the world after leaders of the biggest artificial-intelligence firms proposed slowing the technology’s development, while a jump in oil prices sapped risk sentiment further.
